data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 游艇甲板的海风香槟
data.description: 破浪前行的私人游艇甲板上，银发如瀑在烈烈海风中起舞。身着金纹比基尼的拉·芙利亚单手托起香槟杯，祖母绿眼眸充满王者的戏谑与挑逗，邀你共饮胜利的美酒。
data.location: luxury yacht teak deck cruising open ocean
data.action: clinking champagne glass, windblown silver hair, leaning on railing with confident alluring smirk
data.lighting: brilliant Mediterranean sun reflecting off deep blue ocean waves
data.mood: dazzling royal glamour, audacious playfulness, sun-drenched opulence
data.promptProse: Standing on a luxury yacht deck in a gold bikini, La Folia raises a champagne glass, her long silver hair flying in the ocean wind with a teasing smile.
data.animaCaption: La Folia raising a champagne glass in the ocean breeze on a luxury yacht.
